findings.issue: openMissionControlModal() function called but does not exist
findings.impact: Clicking Mission Control action throws JavaScript error, breaks functionality
findings.fix: Changed to openTerminalModal() which is the correct function

findings.issue: No loading state or visual feedback during team spawn
findings.impact: Users unsure if button click worked, no indication of ongoing process
findings.fix: Made function async, added button disable state, changed text to 'Spawning...', added badge animations, proper error handling with try-catch-finally

findings.issue: Agent badges static with no tooltips or interactivity
findings.impact: Users don't know what each agent specializes in
findings.fix: Added title attributes with role descriptions: Frontend (React, Next.js), Backend (APIs, databases), DevOps (deployment, CI/CD), QA (testing, validation), Security (auth, encryption)

findings.issue: Agent badges lack hover states and animation feedback
findings.impact: Static UI feels unresponsive, no visual confirmation during spawn
findings.fix: Added hover state with blue accent color and slight lift, created .spawning class with badgePulse animation (1.5s infinite), badges pulse during team spawn

findings.issue: Original implementation had no error recovery path
findings.impact: If spawn fails, button stays disabled and badges stuck in loading state
findings.fix: Added comprehensive try-catch-finally with proper error messages, state restoration guaranteed in finally block, both button and badges always reset
